event_name: Date 02 May 2021 Time 16:35 2021 PORTUGUESE GRAND PRIX 29 April - 2 May 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
incident_time: Penalty. (1 penalty point imposed, total of 1 point in the 12-month period)
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5.1.d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed multiple angles of video evidence. Car 9 had just departed the pits with Car 11 approaching down the main straight. Car 9 turned into the apex of Turn 3 while Car 11 was attempting to overtake on the inside at the entrance to the corner. Car 11 was forced to abandon the pass and lock up to avoid a collision. While not mitigating the breach of the regulations, the Stewards note that Car 9 did not have a radio warning in time to react.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 9 Ignoring Blue Flags
